_note: Model names live HERE only. Code references tiers, never model strings. Swap a model by editing this file; nothing else changes. A mission picks its worker with "worker_tier" (default "worker").

worker._what: Default. The loop drives the local model over Ollama's /api/chat and applies its SEARCH/REPLACE edits. 32k context is Ollama's default on a 24 GB card.

worker_claude_code._what: Claude Code itself as the worker, on the local model via Ollama's Anthropic-compatible endpoint. More agency, bigger prompt. Ollama recommends 64k+ context for this: start the server with OLLAMA_CONTEXT_LENGTH=65536 and check `ollama ps` shows 100% GPU.

worker_haiku._what: The swap for when a local model stalls: the same Claude Code worker on Haiku, using your Claude login. Spends real tokens; pair it with reviewer_budget_usd on the mission.

reviewer._what: Only used when a mission sets review_each_keep. One short Claude call per kept change, capped per call.
